subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — Cartful / Redwood demo & pilot details
messages:
From: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@cartful.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot inquiry — Redwood inference for Cartful

Hi Olga,

I signed up for Redwood's self-serve this week (great onboarding!), and after running a few quick tests we're keen to explore a short pilot / proof-of-concept for product search reranking. A few quick details up front:

- Primary use case: rerank search results with relevance + recency signals
- Approx traffic today: ~50k search queries/day, 200k monthly active sessions; expect 2-3x in 6 months
- Latency expectations: p95 ~150ms for single-shot ranking calls
- Security: customer PII in session context, likely require encryption at rest and SSO for console access

We started on self-serve but would love a short technical demo and to discuss pilot scope, expected costs, and timeline. Could we set up a 30–45m call next week? Our Head of Search (technical) and an engineering lead would join.

Thanks — happy to share a small traffic sample if that helps.

Best,
Ethan
Head of Product, Cartful
ethan.moore@cartful.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot inquiry — Redwood inference for Cartful

Forwarding inbound from Cartful. They signed up self-serve and are already running small tests; they're explicitly looking for a short pilot focused on search reranking. They call out PII in session context and SSO for console access.

Ben — can you own qualification and calendar coordination? Key things to confirm before the call:
- Exact concurrency / tokens per request (they gave daily queries but we need per-call token estimate)
- Which attendees: technical + decision-maker?
- Desired pilot timeline (start/end) and success criteria
- Any procurement gates (PO/contract person) we should know about

I've attached their usage snapshot they uploaded. Monica — looping you in for pilot onboarding & SSO discussion.

Attachments: cartful-usage-snapshot.csv (usage export, 2.3KB)

Thanks,
Olga
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@cartful.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — Redwood inference for Cartful

Hi Ethan — thanks for reaching out and great to hear you made progress on self-serve. I can take this next step and run a quick qualification so the demo is tailored to your needs. A few quick questions so we make the 30–45m worthwhile: 

1) Per-request payload: for reranking, do you send the full result set (avg 10 candidates) + session context? Ballpark token count per request?
2) Peak concurrent calls you expect during the pilot window (e.g., 50 rps, 200 rps, etc.)
3) Timeline: are you targeting a pilot start in June/July/Aug? Any hard go-live date?
4) Data residency & security: do you need a Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment or will hosted with dedicated capacity suffice?
5) Attendees: engineering lead + Head of Search are great — is there a procurement contact we should include for later steps?

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 25 May 2027 — 10:00–10:45
- Wed 26 May 2027 — 13:00–13:45
- Thu 27 May 2027 — 08:30–09:15

If none of those work, send two windows that fit your team and I’ll match. For the call I’ll bring a short 10-min deck on pilot scope and metrics, Monica will cover SSO/PII considerations and success criteria.

Quick attachments: redwood-pilot-deck.pdf (5 slides)
Calendly: https://cal.example.com/bencarter/30m

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@cartful.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — Redwood inference for Cartful

Thanks Ben — those slots look good. Quick answers below, and we can lock the Tue 25 May 10:00–10:45 PDT slot if that still works.

- Tokens per request: approx 1.2k tokens (we send top-10 candidates and ~200 tokens of session context)
- Peak concurrency in pilot: expecting ~60 rps peak (we’ll shape traffic during pilot)
- Timeline: target pilot start late May, aiming for a production decision by mid-Aug (Q3 delivery)
- Security: hosted Dedicated is likely fine for pilot; SSO (SAML) for console access required before production
- Attendees: my Engineering Lead (Nina Patel) and our Platform PM (Samir Rao). Procurement contact: leah.jenkins@cartful.com (for PO/terms)

Tue 25 May 10:00 PDT works — please send calendar invite and brief agenda (10m demo, 25m Q&A/traffic review, next steps). We'd also appreciate a short list of data you'll need for the pilot so engineering can prepare an export.

On the usage snapshot: happy to share a sanitized sample of 12k requests if that helps for perf checks — I can send before the call.

Thanks — Ethan
Head of Product | Cartful
ethan.moore@cartful.com
